headline: Payments via personal QR codes: State Tax Service does not yet intend to block business accounts
summary: The State Tax Service is not currently planning strict measures against entrepreneurs who accept payments to personal QR codes instead of corporate ones. The statement was made in the source article.
why: Tax treatment of digital payments affects how small businesses in Kyrgyzstan handle cash flow and compliance. The story is a local regulatory update with limited market reach.
original_headline: Оплата по личным QR-кодам: ГНС пока не намерена блокировать счета бизнеса
